title: TopologyV2Ref
description: Reference anchor for a node/edge to a canonical resource outside the topology graph (inventory, cloud IDs, telemetry, etc.). The pair (`type`, `id`) is the reference identity; a node/edge may carry multiple refs to support composition across graphs and stable linking to upstream systems.

id.description: Reference identifier within the namespace. Often a UUID, ARN, or a deterministic composite key (e.g., deviceId#ifName).
